thread:
bryan: Quick sync — we need a concrete launch criteria and phased rollout for Private (VPC + on‑prem) by EOD Friday. Customers pushing for air‑gapped option.

maria: Agree. Can we distill to 3 phases? e.g. Phase 0: VPC control plane GA, Phase 1: on‑prem packaged installer, Phase 2: air‑gapped installer + HSM/KMS integration.

aj: Sounds good. Important to call out non‑goals per phase (no multi‑cluster orchestration in P0).

kai: From infra side, P0 needs: infra templates, secure bootstrap, telemetry opt‑out, and a recovery playbook.

sophie: For launch criteria we should require: 1) compliance checklist signed by Security, 2) 2 customer beta installs with runbook, 3) perf SLOs: p95 latency under target on dedicated capacity.

bryan: +1. Can we make those measurable? e.g. "2 successful installs" = automated install completes + smoke tests pass for 2 customers within identical network conditions.

securitybot: Security checklist items: network segmentation docs, default deny policies, KMS/HSM integration tested, audit log retention min 90 days.

maria: Customer asks — one enterprise wants full air‑gap with manual image transfer. That adds packaging complexity and signed manifests. Proposal: treat air‑gap as Phase 2 and require a supported offline installer toolchain.

aj: Timeline ask: engineering capacity realistically 6 weeks for P0 if we reduce scope: focus on VPC control plane + simple on‑prem installer (helm + systemd unit). If we add full air‑gap support earlier, add 3–4 weeks.

kai: Dependency: ops needs a hardened image build pipeline and signing keys. Ops: can you estimate effort?

ops-desk: We can stand up an image signing flow in ~2 weeks but need access to KMS and an ownership matrix. Air‑gap packaging adds another 2 weeks for offline bundle tooling and docs.

sophie: Docs and runbooks: must include rollback steps, emergency keys rotation, and troubleshooting section with common logs. SRE will need a playbook for canary revert.

bryan: Action items: Maria — draft phase definitions + non‑goals; Kai — infra checklist + perf targets; Aj — engineering estimate; Ops — image signing plan; Sophie — documentation & runbook skeleton. Can everyone comment on doc by tomorrow?

maria: Will do, I’ll add customer impact notes and acceptance tests.

aj: I’ll push time estimates and a draft Gantt.

kai: I’ll add the SKUs/hardware matrix and p95 target numbers.

ops-desk: Noted. Will also include required IAM roles and rotation cadence.

bryan: One more callout — telemetry: we must default to minimal telemetry with explicit opt‑in, and expose an enterprise opt‑in config (toggle in install). Security signoff required.

securitybot: Confirmed — default minimal telemetry. Also require field for contact info for incident escalation in the private control plane config.

sophie: If we hit scope creep on air‑gap, recommend gating with an internal E2E test harness so we don’t ship without regression coverage.

bryan: Perfect. If no objections, I’ll consolidate and post a proposal doc by EOD. :thumbsup:

maria: No objections. +:eyes:

aj: Fine by me.

kai: OK

ops-desk: 👍

sophie: :shipit:
